messages:
maria_cs: Heads up — onboarding account 'Persephone' showing an early spend spike, want to triage before the QBR. Topline: embedding calls up ~6x after yesterday's prod push. Anyone see immediate red flags?

lina_csm: Noted. They're still in onboarding credits. Which signal should we treat as the official flag — token burn rate or total request volume?

sam_finops: Quick scan: if growth stays the same we're looking at ~ $12.4k over committed by month-end. Main driver = embeddings, ~85% of tokens. I'll paste a mini-forecast below.

joel_se: They flipped on batched embedding in staging yesterday, might be misconfigured for prod. Could be causing sudden spikes if batch-size is too small and RPS high.

billing-bot: Alert: account Persephone crossed 70% of onboarding credits threshold. Auto-flag created (ID: auto-7842).

ashley_revops: Recommend we propose a temporary spend cap + an enablement doc explaining caching/quantization tradeoffs. I can own outreach.

maria_cs: OK actioning: @ashley_revops pls own cap & comms; @joel_se pls propose config changes; @sam_finops pls confirm forecast numbers for the QBR deck. Also capture customer feedback re: accuracy vs cost.

lina_csm: I'll pull recent logs and top prompt patterns and add to the QBR appendix. Any preferred ask-template for the customer feedback survey?

sam_finops: Forecast snippet for the deck:
```
current_month_estimate: $28,400
committed: $16,000
gap: $12,400
primary_cause: embeddings (85%)
mitigations: cache, quantization, batching
```
I'll convert into a slide and share by EOD.

joel_se: Config suggestion to reduce RPS pressure:
```bash
redwoodctl set-rate --account Persephone --max-rps 120 --batch-size 8
```
Also enable prefix caching for the top 10 prompts.

ashley_revops: I'll draft the cap email + enablement playbook. Target send: 2pm PST tomorrow. Will include a one-pager on quick quantization settings we recommend and suggested language for “pause & review” if they hit thresholds.

maria_cs: Perfect. Logging action items in the QBR ticket. If anyone sees an uptick in support tickets tied to unexpected charges, please ping #customer-alarms immediately. :white_check_mark:

lina_csm: Adding final note: capturing customer sentiment line: "We love the accuracy but need cheaper embedding options for bulk ops." I'll add that to /qbr/persephone/appendix_cost.md and the feedback tracker.

maria_cs: Thanks team — we'll reconvene once slides + email drafts are ready.
